newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse says closing data being adjusted.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse says closing data being adjusted.

text.p: The Brussels Stock Exchange said on Monday market data had suffered technical problems in afternoon trading, forcing it to readjust closing share prices and the closing level for the Bel-20 share index.
"The system has suffered from technical problems but it will ready in 30 minutes," a bourse official told Reuters at 1600 GMT.
Closing prices and the Bel-20 close reported at 1535 GMT are to be treated as suspect.
